title: Vespa Sidecar Tour in Rome with Cappuccino
overview: Skip the crowded coach tours and discover the highlights of the Eternal City from a Vespa sidecar. Each motorcycle and sidecar fits two people (plus driver), so you can settle back with a friend or loved one as you cruise by attractions from the Colosseum to the Trevi Fountain. Tours include live narration via convenient headphones for crucial context on each site, plus a traditional Roman breakfast of cappuccino and cornetto.
inclusions: Professional Licensed Guide with live commentary through headphones

title: Rome Vespa Tour with Professional Photographer
overview: Capture your Roman holiday in style on this Vespa tour with an accompanying professional photographer. Drive by many notable landmarks, including the Colosseum and the Castel Sant'Angelo, for a comprehensive overview of the Eternal City. Avoid the disappointment of taking sub-par vacation snaps—your driver–photographer–guide will take you to the most scenic spots, then take beautiful photos of you.

title: Colosseum Tour with Arena Floor & Roman Forum | Semi-Private
overview: If you’re interested in ancient Roman history, take this small-group guided tour that includes access to the Colosseum’s arena floor, the Roman Forum, and Palatine Hill. Learn more from your guide than you would wandering around by yourself, and ask lots of questions, which isn’t easy on larger tours. See where ancient gladiatorial battles were fought, and where governance decisions were made, at these must-visit sites.
inclusions: Colosseum entrance with Exclusive access to arena floor
startDescription: Meet your guide at the confirmed Colosseum-area meeting point listed when booking.

title: Full-Day: Colosseum, Vatican Museums & St Peter's Guided Tour
overview: With this full-day tour, save time by visiting Rome’s most legendary attractions in one day: the Colosseum and the Vatican. After meeting your guide and group, start your day with a comprehensive tour of the Vatican, visiting the museums, the Sistine Chapel, and St. Peter's Basilica. Then, after a short break for lunch (own expense), tour the Colosseum, Palatine Hill, and the Roman Forum.
inclusions: Guided Tours of Colosseum, Roman Forum, Palatine Hill, Vatican Museums, St Peter's Basilica
startDescription: Colosseum morning meet at Largo Gaetana Agnesi, 00184 Roma RM. Vatican afternoon meet at Via Tunisi, 4, 00192 Roma.

title: Rome by E-bike: the guided tour of the city center
overview: Go beyond your standard walking tour on this fun, sustainable adventure through Rome. Led by your personal guide, you'll hop on an e-bike to see both the Eternal City's most-famous attractions and a few hidden gems along the way. You’ll zip from piazzas and squares to ancient ruins and beyond, discovering far more than you would on foot —and still traveling green.
startDescription: Meet your guide at the confirmed Rome e-bike meeting location listed when booking. The route uses city-center streets and the Tiber cycle path.

overview: Leave central Rome for a private countryside wine tasting with hotel pickup and drop-off. Taste selected wines with local gastronomic specialties at a family-run vineyard, then return to the city after a guided cellar visit. The half-day format is built for visitors who want Roman wine country without planning rural transfers on their own.

title: Rome Walking Food Tour With Secret Food Tours
overview: Get a taste of true Roman fare while exploring the city’s unique districts on this food walking tour. Follow your local guide—and your appetite—to authentic eateries in the Piazza Navona, Campo de' Fiori, and the Jewish Quarter. Learn about Rome’s fascinating history while stopping to sample local specialties such as espresso, pizza, fried risotto balls called suppli, Roman pasta, cheeses, and artisinal gelato. Enjoy a Secret Dish revealed on the day of the tour.
inclusions: Three different types of homemade Pizza
startDescription: Sant'Agnese in Agone, Piazza Navona, 14, 00186 Roma RM, Italy. Ends at Largo di Torre Argentina.

title: Rome: Vatican Museums and St. Peter's Basilica Small Group Tour
overview: Avoid being just a number on an impersonal large tour and enjoy an intimate experience on this small-group tour of the Vatican Museums and St. Peter’s Basilica. Save time with skip-the-line access so you can go straight to the stunning art and architecture. Listen to your guide’s interesting commentary as they lead you through the rich, ornate Vatican Museums, the Sistine Chapel, and St. Peter's Basilica.
startDescription: Meet your guide at the confirmed Vatican Museums meeting point listed when booking.

title: Borghese Gallery Max 6 People Tour: Baroque & Renaissance in Rome
overview: Explore a treasure trove of baroque and Renaissance art at Rome's Borghese Gallery—and discover insider facts you'd miss if visiting on your own—on this small-group tour. Housed in a 17th-century palazzo, the museum is home to world-class collection by Italian masters like Caravaggio, Bernini, Canova, and Raphael. See many of the gallery’s most important paintings and sculptures while your guide shares stories about the artists and patrons behind them.
startDescription: Outside the main entrance to the Borghese Gallery, Piazzale del Museo Borghese, 00197 Roma. Your guide will be holding a LivTours sign.

title: Rome EBike Tour: Appian Way, Catacombs & Roman Aqueducts
overview: Venture outside of Rome’s historic center to marvel at ancient sights that most tourists miss with this electric-assist bicycle tour along the Ancient Appian Way. Check out the ruins of the Aurelian Walls, Circus of Maxentius, and the ancient Roman aqueducts, all the while cycling with ease through the countryside. Choose a 4-hour or 6-hour tour to suit your schedule; the longer tour includes a guided visit inside the 2nd-century catacombs.
inclusions: Guided visit of the Catacombs of San Callisto or San Sebastiano (ONLY IN THE 6-HOUR TOUR)

title: Rome by Night eBike Tour with Pizza Option
overview: Experience the most beautiful time in Rome when you explore at twilight—and see more sights in one tour than you could on your own—all thanks to this electric bike excursion. With just your guide and small group for company, watch the sunset and pass by major monuments such as the Colosseum, Roman Forum, Pantheon, and Trevi Fountain. If you've upgraded when booking, enjoy an authentic Roman pizza afterwards.
inclusions: Optional Pizza (to choose at booking stage)
startDescription: Meet your guide at the confirmed Rome night e-bike meeting location listed when booking.

Your guide will take you to four carefully selected eateries in the historic neighborhood where you can sample authentic Roman dishes, from street food and cured meats to baccalà and gelato. You'll also sit down for a meal at a restaurant and drink wine and beer.
